products.name: Soundraw
products.note: Royalty-free AI music; commercial license; JASRAC considerations for Japan use

profile_text.body:
Soundraw is an AI music generator that allows users to create royalty-free beats and tracks without musical training or a digital audio workstation. The company describes itself as built by musicians for the purpose of making music creation easy and accessible, and its platform lets users select from more than 30 genres, blend styles such as Hip-Hop with Orchestra or Trap with Lo-Fi, and refine results through an in-app editor with bar-level controls for muting, soloing, and adjusting intensity. Finished tracks can be downloaded as high-quality WAV files or as separate stems.

Soundraw's stated legal position centers on the fact that its AI is trained exclusively on music written and recorded by its own in-house producers, meaning the company holds the master recordings and publishing rights to every piece of music in its training catalog. The company states that every generated track carries a worldwide, perpetual commercial license and that users keep 100% of royalties when publishing to platforms such as YouTube, Spotify, or TikTok. The held facts note that Japanese users should be aware of JASRAC considerations when using the service. Soundraw also states it is a supporter of the aiformusic initiative, an effort centered on the responsible use of AI in music, alongside Roland and UMG.
